title: Sign-coded separation failure set
statement: Let $n$, $\ell$, and $m$ be nonnegative integers. The sign-coded separation failure set consists of those sequences of $m$ vectors in $\{−1,1\}^n$ whose corresponding Boolean-cube samples fail to separate the low-degree coefficient arrays.
caveat: The sign encoding and separation-failure set definitions are not included in the supplied snippet.
